purpose: Decompose 'what is an effective feature' into measurable transforms and test each with one fixed linear probe, so differences are attributable to the feature only.

data.eeg: public train only, 50 ms log1p counts, per-session z-score fitted on the three training repeats

probe.model: nearest class mean, Euclidean, per session, centroids from the three training repeats
probe.rationale: fixed capacity so that feature transforms, not model capacity, drive the difference; after whitening Euclidean nearest-centroid equals LDA scoring

transforms.l2: base then L2 normalise each trial vector
transforms.trial_z: base then z-score across features within each trial
transforms.common_mode: base minus the trial mean across all features, then per-session z-score
transforms.pca_white: base then PCA fitted on training repeats, whiten by inverse square root eigenvalues, keep 256 components
transforms.wccn: base then within-class covariance whitening with shrinkage 0.1, fitted on training repeats
transforms.unit_top128: base then zero all but the 128 units with the highest ANOVA F on training repeats, per session

noise_structure.residual: trial minus its class mean, computed on training repeats per session

metrics.recall32: fraction of held trials whose character is in the probe top-32

pass_rule.effective_feature: a transform is effective if recall32 exceeds base for both mice and in at least 3 of 4 folds for each mouse
pass_rule.no_selection_on_metric: no transform parameter (components, shrinkage, k) may be tuned on the held repeat; values are fixed in this file

prohibited: tuning transform hyperparameters on the held repeat
